response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice WHERE BillingState IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BillingState), s AS (SELECT g.*, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share, (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM g) AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_invoices, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt
